Based on the search results, here is how to log into OneDrive:

## Logging into OneDrive

### **Via Web Browser**
1. Go to **https://onedrive.com** or **https://onedrive.live.com**
2. Click the **"Sign in"** button
3. Enter your **Microsoft account email address** or phone number
4. Enter your **password**
5. Click **"Sign in"** to access your files

### **Via Windows App (Windows 10/11)**
1. Click the **Start button** and search for **"OneDrive"**
2. Open the OneDrive app
3. When OneDrive Setup starts, enter your **Microsoft account email address**
4. Enter your **password** and follow the prompts to complete setup

### **Via Mobile App (iOS/Android)**
1. Download the OneDrive app from the App Store or Google Play Store
2. Open the app and tap **"Sign in"**
3. Enter your Microsoft account email and password

---

## Important Notes

- **OneDrive uses your Microsoft account** — the same email and password you use for Outlook, Xbox, or other Microsoft services
- If you have both **personal and work/school accounts**, they can be distinguished by icon color:
  - **White cloud icon** = Personal OneDrive
  - **Blue cloud icon** = Work/School OneDrive

---

## Troubleshooting Login Issues

If you encounter problems signing in:

| Issue | Solution |
|-------|----------|
| Forgot password | Click **"Forgot password"** on the sign-in page to reset it |
| Stuck on "Signing in" | Try unlinking and re-linking: OneDrive icon → ⚙️ Settings → **"Unlink this PC"** → Sign in again |
| Error 0x8004de40/0x8004de44 | Check TLS settings: Run `inetcpl.cpl` → Advanced tab → Enable **TLS 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3** |
| Account sync issues | Run Command Prompt as Administrator, type `dsregcmd /leave` then `dsregcmd /join`, then restart |

---

## Switching or Adding Accounts

To **switch to a different account**:
1. Right-click the OneDrive cloud icon in the taskbar
2. Select **Settings** → **Account** tab → **"Unlink this PC"**
3. Sign in with your new account credentials

To **add an additional account** (personal + work):
1. Right-click OneDrive icon → **Settings** → **Account** tab
2. Click **"Add an account"**
3. Sign in with your second Microsoft account

---

Sources:
1. https://one-drive.helpshift.com/hc/faq/10-how-to-sign-in-to-onedrive-account/
2. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/answers/questions/5652321/how-do-i-sign-to-onedrive
3. https://www.xda-developers.com/how-to-sign-into-onedrive/
4. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/answers/questions/5651952/how-to-log-into-one-drive-from-home-computer
5. https://www.solveyourtech.com/how-to-change-onedrive-account-on-windows-11-a-step-by-step-guide-2/
6. https://www.supportyourtech.com/articles/how-to-change-onedrive-account-on-windows-10-a-step-by-step-guide/
7. https://www.supportyourtech.com/articles/how-to-add-another-onedrive-account-on-windows-11-a-step-by-step-guide/
8. https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/sharepoint/troubleshoot/sync/error-0x8004de40-in-onedrive
